ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ الَّذِيْنَ اتَّعَظُوْا مِنْهُ بِجَمِيْلِ الْمَوَاعِظِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhīna ‘tta`aẓū minhu bi jamīli ‘l-mawā`iẓ.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family who heeded him in his beautiful sermons!

ar: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ النُّوْرِ السَّاطِعِ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, An-Nūri ‘s-sāṭi`.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, the radiant light!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ الَّذِيْ تَلْتَذُّ بِحَدِيْثِهِ الْمَسَامِعُ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Alladhī taltadhdhu bi ḥadīthihi ‘l-masāmi`.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family whose narration pleases the listener!
